# SD18 deterministic Human Fighter level 17 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic Human Fighter pilot from the bounded
# level 16 (eighth bonus-feat cadence slot) tranche to level 17 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam and the
# deterministic Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield posture. Level 17 grants
# no new bonus feat (the cadence is 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, ..., and 17
# is not in it); instead it raises Weapon Training to rank 4, which requires
# choosing a FOURTH weapon group (canonically Hammers), so this fixture adds
# the choice:fighter_weapon_training_group_4 selection (canonically
# group:hammers). No hammer is part of the deterministic loadout, so this
# fourth-group seam stays explanation-only, mirroring the second (Bows) and
# third (Polearms) groups.
